title: Saalbach Hinterglemm Catalog Curation - normalized model migration
summary: Migrates PR #15 onto the normalized Snowcast catalog. Facts are assigned to explicit regions, stay destinations, stay bases, ski areas, access edges, terrain domains, pass products, and rental facts. Source-aware v2 enrichment follow-up: Reviewed Saalbach and Skicircus facts against official operator and destination sources. Added published 90% snowmaking coverage, four freestyle parks, floodlit night skiing, marked ski-route availability, official piste map, destination-defining apres, base elevation, mixed character, lively pace, and local apres while retaining unsupported glacier terrain and route count as unknown.
